result:
All 14 queries ran against their input files and returned plausible answers. I only spot-checked a few totals by hand and did not check the rest against the data.

- **N2:** after the discount, Initech comes to 314.97 and Acme to 147.49.
- **N10:** `qlang` has no trim verb, so I strip stray spaces by splitting on spaces and rejoining. That would damage a multi-word tag. A grep of `articles.txt` found no such tag.
- **N11:** I ran this one with no input file.
- **N14:** I used `--raw` for the text files (N6, N7, N10, N14). Their answers print as `qlang` literals, not JSON.

N1: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | type | eq ::string) * (/email | split "@" | /1 | lower) | distinct | sort
N2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid")  * {:c /customer/name :a ((/lines * (mul /qty /unit_price) | sum)) :d (at :discount | coalesce 0)} * {:c /c :a (sub /a /d)} | groupBy ~(/c) * (* /a | sum) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | round 2)} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
N3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (at :assignee | coalesce {:login "unassigned"} | /login) | groupBy * count
N4: [(at :dependencies | coalesce {}) (at :devDependencies | coalesce {})] * entries | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * (/0 | keyword) | sort
N5: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | vals | {:enabledCount count :ports (* at :port | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | distinct | sort) :totalReplicas (* (at :replicas | coalesce 1) | sum)}
N6: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") * (split "[" | /1 | split "]" | /0) | groupBy * count | entries * {:service (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /service]) | take 2
N7: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split "," | filter ~(every ~(count | gt 0)) * {:r (/0 | lower) :v (mul (/2 | parseJson) (/3 | parseJson))} | groupBy ~(/r) * (* /v | sum | round 2)
N8: :ev / | (filter ~(/type | lower | eq "login") * /user | distinct) | minus (ev | filter ~(/type | lower | eq "logout") * /user | distinct) | sort
N9: filter ~(at :salary | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~(/dept) * {:s (* /salary | sum) :n count} * (div /s /n | round 1)
N10: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split ":" | /1 | split ",") | flat * (lower | split " " | filter ~(count | gt 0) | join "") | distinct | sort
N11: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","apple","date"] * lower | groupBy * count | entries * {:word (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | filter ~(/count | gt 1) | sort ~([(/count | desc) /word])
N12: /releases | filter ~(/draft | eq false) | filter ~(/prerelease | eq false) * {:tag /tag_name :downloads (at :assets | coalesce [] | * (at :download_count | coalesce 0) | sum)} | sort ~(/downloads | desc) | take 3
N13: filter ~(/category | lower | eq "tools") | {:count count :allPriced (every ~(at :price | coalesce 0 | gt 0)) :inStockNames (filter ~(/stock | gt 0) * /name | sort)}
N14: lines * (split "#" | /0 | split " " | filter ~(count | gt 0) | join "") | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "-" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") * (split "==") | filter ~(count | eq 2) * [(/0 | lower | keyword) /1] | tag ::map
